llm_reason: Round 2 fallback diagnosis (architecture scale): ED lever stack is solved (546-589 vs 500.94) and T_max solved by h=200, but the 4C charge fails at START-OF-CHARGE: Chen2020 exchange-current densities are concentration-dependent, so at the discharged state (anode nearly delithiated, cathode fully lithiated) i0 -> 0 on BOTH electrodes and 20 A produces a giant activation polarization: anode surface potential collapses below 0 V (plating) and terminal voltage spikes to 4.2 V (trip). R2C showed current-density dilution x1.5 gets furthest (1.44 Ah, borderline -5.7 mV). Round 3 attacks the polarization at its root with zero-to-low ED cost: smaller particle radii (active area a_s=3eps/r up ~2x at 1.5 um, ~3x at 1.0 um; solid diffusion time r^2/D down 3.4-7.7x), N/P up (residual anode lithium at discharge end keeps i0 finite; more anode active area; ED cost ~6% at N/P 1.2), area x1.5 dilution. Particle radii 1.0-1.5 um are primary-particle-scale values (ultra-fast-charge formulation class, manufacturable; noted as aggressive).
